## Gold-standard algorithms {.shrink}

### RNA mapping (short-read single-cell)

:::: {.columns}
::: {.column}
::: {.incremental}

- Alignment
  - [STARsolo](https://github.com/alexdobin/STAR/blob/master/docs/STARsolo.md)
  - STAR algorithm + barcode correction and UMI collapsing
  - Genome index, splice-aware
  - Alex Dobin (Cold Spring Harbor)
  
:::
:::
::: {.column}
::: {.incremental}

- Pseudo-alignment
  - [kb-python](https://github.com/pachterlab/kb_python)
    - [kallisto](https://github.com/pachterlab/kallisto)
      - 'Bag of k-mers'
      - Fast but no BAM
    - [bustools](https://github.com/BUStools/bustools) 
      - Correct barcodes, collapse UMIs, gene count or tcc)
  - Lior Pachter (Cal Tech)

:::
:::
::::

## Gold-standard algorithms {.shrink}

### RNA mapping (short-read single-cell)

:::: {.columns}
::: {.column width="95%"}
::: {.incremental}

- Selective Alignment
  - [simpleaf](https://github.com/COMBINE-lab/simpleaf)
    - [salmon](https://salmon.readthedocs.io/en/latest/salmon.html) 
      - Find exact transcriptome index matches, chain them to positions, then run a fast banded alignment (Smith-Watterman) for score
    - [piscem](https://github.com/COMBINE-lab/piscem)
      - Constraint chaining, rejection of reads whose k-mers are present but structurally inconsistent (direction, spacing); no banded alignment
      - Returns a mapping position (used in UMI dedup) but no CIGAR
    - [alevin-fry](https://github.com/COMBINE-lab/alevin-fry) 
      - Turns salmon/piscem output to cell x gene matrix
  - Rob Patro (Univ. of Maryland)
  
:::
:::
::: {.column}
::: {.incremental}



:::
:::
::::

:::: {.columns}

## Hierarchical Data Format

- .h5, .hdf5
- Works with datasets larger than your RAM
- In R
  - HDF5Array and DelayedArray packages
  - Seurat and SingleCellExperiment read h5 directly
- Python: h5py and [AnnData backed mode](https://deepwiki.com/scverse/anndata/4.2-backed-mod)


## Analysis in Python

- [scanpy](https://github.com/scverse/scanpy)
 - Scales to larger datasets >1M cells
 - faster
- [AnnData objects](https://anndata.readthedocs.io/en/latest/index.html)
- bioconda

```python
#!/usr/bin/env python3
import scanpy as sc

# From .mtx
adata = sc.read_10x_mtx("outs/filtered_feature_bc_matrix/",
                        var_names="gene_symbols", cache=True)
# Or from .h5
adata = sc.read_10x_h5("outs/filtered_feature_bc_matrix.h5")

```

# Analysis in R

## Single-cell experiment (SCE) {.shrink}

- Subclass that extends [SummarizedExperiment](https://bioconductor.org/packages/3.23/bioc/vignettes/SummarizedExperiment/inst/doc/SummarizedExperiment.html) S4 class
  - SummarizedExperiment functions work with SCE 
  - reducedDims, altExps
  - [SCE documentation](https://bioconductor.org/books/3.13/OSCA.intro/the-singlecellexperiment-class.html)

![](figures/SingleCellExperiment_organization.png){width="50%"}

## SCE packages

  - `DropletUtils` Utilities for droplet data.
  - `scuttle` Computes per-cell QC metrics; basic normalization & log-transformation.
  - `scater` Plots QC and expression; runs PCA, t-SNE, and UMAP.
  - `scran` Size-factor normalization, highly variable gene selection, and marker detection.
  - `bluster` graph-based, k-means, and hierarchical clustering.
  - `batchelor` Corrects batch effects and integrates datasets; fastMNN.
  - `scDblFinder` Detects doublets.
  - `BiocSingular` Runs fast approximate PCA/SVD on large datasets.
  - `BiocNeighbors` Performs fast nearest-neighbor searches for graph building and UMAP.
  - `edgeR` Differential expression

## Seurat Package

[Seurat vignettes](https://satijalab.org/seurat/articles/get_started_v5_new)

### Install

```{r}
if (!requireNamespace("Seurat", quietly = TRUE)) {
  BiocManager::install("Seurat")
}
library(Seurat)
```

### Seurat Object Class

- S4 container for single-cell data (`SeuratObject` package)
- Holds raw counts, normalized data, metadata, and analysis results together
- Created from a count matrix


## Seurat Object Class Main Slots

| Slot          | Contents                                         |
|---------------|--------------------------------------------------|
| `assays`      | Expression data (e.g. `RNA`)       |
| `meta.data`   | Per-cell annotations (nCount, nFeature, clusters) |
| `reductions`  | PCA, UMAP, t-SNE embeddings                      |
| `graphs`      | SNN / KNN graphs used for clustering             |
| `active.ident`| Current cell identities (clusters)               |
| `commands`    | Log of Seurat functions run                      |


## Accessing Seurat Data {.shrink}

```{r}
dim(seu)                  # genes x cells
head(seu@meta.data)       # cell metadata
seu$percent.mt <- PercentageFeatureSet(seu, pattern = "^MT-") # get MT pct

Idents(seu)               # active identities
Embeddings(seu, "umap")   # Get Cell Embeddings 

colnames(seu) # Cell names
Cells(seu)

Features(seu) # Feature names
rownames(seu)

# List of object layers
Layers(seu) # e.g. "counts"

# working with multimodal objects list assays
Assays(seu) # e.g. "RNA"

# Assay-specific features
Features(seu[["RNA"]])

```

## Convert Between Seurat & SingleCellExperiment

```{r}

# Seurat -> SCE
sce <- Seurat::as.SingleCellExperiment(seu)

# SCE -> Seurat
seu <- SeuratObject::as.Seurat(sce, counts = "counts", data = "logcounts")
# as.Seurat imported with Seurat

```

## AnnotationDbi

- [AnnotationDbi](https://bioconductor.org/packages/3.23/bioc/vignettes/AnnotationDbi/inst/doc/IntroToAnnotationPackages.pdf)
  - Organism and TxDb 
  - org.Hs.eg.db and TxDb.Hsapiens.UCSC.hg38.knownGene
  
```{r}
# map sce ENS genes to symbol
library(org.Hs.eg.db)
ens <- rownames(sce)
rowData(sce)$symbol  <- mapIds(org.Hs.eg.db,
                               keys      = ens,
                               column    = "SYMBOL",
                               keytype   = "ENSEMBL",
                               multiVals = "first")
```

## Molecular Signatures
  
- [Molecular Signatures DataBase](https://www.gsea-msigdb.org/gsea/msigdb/collections.jsp) 
  - 9 major collections
- [msigdbr](https://github.com/igordot/msigdbr) R package
  - provides Molecular Signatures Database (MSigDB) gene sets
- ssGSEA to assign pathway score to all cells
 
## Batch Correction

- [scvi-tools](https://docs.scvi-tools.org/en/stable/user_guide/index.html)
  - Python
- [Harmony](https://portals.broadinstitute.org/harmony/articles/quickstart.html)
  - Returns corrected PC embeddings
  - Iterative soft k-means clustering
- [batchelor](https://bioconductor.posit.co/packages/release/bioc/vignettes/batchelor/inst/doc/correction.html)
  - Returns corrected PC embeddings & counts
  - fastMNN

:::: {.columns}

## Cell Annotation
### Tools
- [singleR](https://bioconductor.org/packages/3.23/bioc/vignettes/SingleR/inst/doc/SingleR.html)
  - transfers labels from a reference dataset without clustering
- [Pan-Human Azimuth](https://azimuth.hubmapconsortium.org/)
  - [Seurat AzimuthAPI](https://satijalab.org/pan_human_azimuth/r/azimuthapi)
  - 23 human tissues and 380 cell types
- [scGate](https://github.com/carmonalab/scGate)
  - in-silico flow cytometry using defined markers
- [scType](https://sctype.app/) 
  – fast marker-based annotation
- [Seurat reference mapping vignette](https://satijalab.org/seurat/articles/integration_mapping) 
  – `FindTransferAnchors` / `MapQuery` workflow

## Gastrulation Dataset

[Mouse Gastrulation Data](https://www.nature.com/articles/s41586-019-0933-9)

- Mouse E8.5 blastocyst injected with ESCs
  - ESCs either td-tomato+ or ctrl
- Control experiment to show that injected ESCs develop into all lineages


```{r, eval=TRUE}

baseDir = '/varidata/researchtemp/hpctmp/single_cell_workshop_2026/day1/data/'
sample_meta <- read.csv(file.path(baseDir, "per_sample_meta.csv"), row.names = 1)
sample_meta

```

## Seurat Read10X dgCMatrix

```{r,eval=TRUE}

library(Seurat)
samples <- paste0("sample", 5:10)
directories <- setNames(nm = samples, object = file.path(baseDir, samples))
counts <- Read10X(directories)
class(counts)
head(colnames(counts))
head(counts[,1:5])
```

## dgCMatrix to Seurat

```{r,eval=TRUE}
# read cell metadata
cell_meta <- read.csv(file.path(baseDir, "per_cell_meta.csv"), row.names = 1)
nrow(cell_meta)==ncol(counts)

rownames(cell_meta) <- paste0('sample',cell_meta$sample, "_", cell_meta$barcode)

table(colnames(counts)%in%rownames(cell_meta))
table(rownames(cell_meta)%in%colnames(counts))

cell_meta <- cell_meta[colnames(counts), colnames(cell_meta)]

```

## dgCMatrix to Seurat

```{r,eval=TRUE}

seu <- CreateSeuratObject(counts, meta.data = cell_meta, project = "workshop")
seu

# commented out, but this is raw_seu.Rds
# saveRDS(seu,'/varidata/researchtemp/hpctmp/single_cell_workshop_2026/day1/data/raw_seu.Rds')

head(seu@meta.data)
```

## dgCMatrix to SingleCellExperiment

```{r,eval=TRUE}

library(SingleCellExperiment)
sce <- SingleCellExperiment(list(counts = counts), colData = cell_meta)
sce

```

## Seurat object structure

```{r,eval=TRUE}
str(seu, max.level = 2)
```

## Seurat object structure

```{r,eval=TRUE}
Seurat::GetAssayData(seu, layer = "counts")[1:5, 1:5]
```
